entities.summary: HD 141937 is a star in the southern zodiac constellation of Libra, positioned a couple of degrees to the north of Lambda Librae. It is a yellow-hued star with an apparent visual magnitude of 7.25, which means it is too faint to be seen with the naked eye. This object is located at a distance of 106.7 light-years from the Sun based on parallax, but is drifting closer with a radial velocity of −3.4 km/s. It has an absolute magnitude of 4.71.
